stem: Which statement about the amygdala and memory is supported by OpenStax Psychology?

options.label: A
options.misconception: None; amygdala participates in fear memories.
options.explanation: OpenStax: the amygdala is involved in fear and fear memories.

options.label: B
options.text: It digests dietary glycogen in hepatocytes
options.misconception: Nonsense — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the final electron acceptor of the ETC
options.misconception: Nonsense — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: D
options.text: It stores all procedural motor skills alone
options.misconception: Procedural memory is more cerebellar/basal ganglia.

options.label: E
options.text: It synthesizes acetyl-CoA for the citric cycle
options.misconception: Biochem nonsense — does not match the cited teaching point.
